input.summary:
P0 attic (box x5..10, y10..12, z15..19) furnished as a storage nook: focal dresser on the west wall (barrels with a chest, facing the ladder), a stair window seat on the north wall, a chest bench on the south wall, a red carpet rug, and two lanterns standing on barrels.
`mcd room --only "P0 attic"` says OK: 30 of 30 floor cells reachable, min light 8, 0 dark, FIT OK. make.sh ran with 16 placed, 0 refused, 0 off-palette; room.png was checked.
Only parts/room-8.mjs was edited; plan.md and elements.md were not ticked, since no room-level checklist item is specific to this attic.
left: Ladder cells at x11 (y6..10, z17) show as UNSUPPORTED in `mcd check` because the east wall at x11 is still a stub in this copy; the shell part should provide that wall when merged.

Stair facing convention is unverified: I used facing = side of the full-height back (toolkit reference), so the window-seat stairs at z15 face north against the wall. The render did not settle it; a close-up of the seat would.

waste.what: Drew the 6x5 attic furniture grid by hand and then re-read the plan grid to check each cell's x/z offset.
waste.tool: A `mcd plan --emit-layers` option that prints a legend-keyed template with the origin already offset, so the designer only fills characters.

waste.what: Guessed the stair facing convention (toolkit says facing = back side, vanilla says the opposite) and had to settle it from docs alone.
waste.tool: A `mcd states` check for stairs that prints the back side in plain words, or a `mcd fit` line naming which way each seat faces.

waste.what: Chose lantern spots by hand from the light math (Manhattan distance minus one per block) before checking them with the tool.
waste.tool: `mcd room --suggest` that places the lanterns itself into the drawn grid, or a `layers` legend entry that marks lantern spots for the lamplighter.

companions.task: Check the two lantern positions and the light map at the feet, and say whether the focal dresser is in the brightest spot; I had to infer both from the Manhattan rule.
Confirm the ladder's entry at x11 z17 (y6..10) and the hole at (11,9,17) line up with the attic floor I furnished, and that the east wall is built where the ladder hangs.
